# Security policy

The supported version is the current `main` branch, used as a private, single-company portfolio
demonstration with synthetic documents. Public hosting and real customer data are outside this release.

Use [GitHub's enabled private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/surajnair17/vendorops-ai/security/advisories/new).
Include the affected commit, prerequisites, a synthetic reproduction, expected behavior, and observed
impact. Do not include credentials, customer documents, or private email contents.

Read the [hardening report](../backend/docs/hardening.md) and
[infrastructure assessment](../backend/docs/infrastructure-checks.md) for tested protections and
remaining limits. Passing tests and dependency audits are evidence, not a security certification.
